welcome.title: Practice everything in one place
welcome.body: Riff keeps your score, your video and your audio side by side, so you stop juggling three windows and start playing.
welcome.status: This early build has the workspace, the settings and the keyboard shortcuts. Playing a score, a video or a track is still to come.

theme.title: Pick a look
theme.body: You can change this at any time in Settings.

privacy.title: Everything stays here
privacy.body: Riff has no accounts, no telemetry and makes no network connections at all. Your files never leave this machine. Here is exactly where Riff keeps things:
